discourse.title: The day that wrought the great change
discourse.excerpt: It was the 20th of October (1940) - a Monday. This is what I declared on that day: Know I am verily Sai. Give up your attachments and attempts; The old relationships are at an end. No one, however eminent, can alter My resolve.
discourse.theme: The 1940 declaration: Know I am verily Sai.

reflection: What does a 1940 declaration ask of me, today? The same three lines He spoke then. 'Give up your attachments' — name one thing you clutch too tightly and loosen your grip on it today. That is how you celebrate Avatar Day: not with noise, but with one small renunciation offered at His feet.

bhajan.title: Manasa Bhajare Guru Charanam (Indonesian Version, Ladies Day Special)

seva_nudge: Write down one attachment you will give up, and offer it to Swami in prayer.
